She explains her past frustration of repeating passes on strands that ruined the shape or roots until trying the WavyTalk Blowout Boost. She demonstrates the 5 digital heat settings, tutorials how to lift from the roots and curl downwards for maximum volume, styles her bangs/front section upwards, reveals the sleek frizz-free results thanks to ionic technology, and delivers an urgent call-to-action featuring a 20% discount and 30-day return policy.

scenes.visual: Creator faces camera showing her naturally frizzy, straight/unbrushed brunette hair.
scenes.action: Creator shakes her head lightly and points out the 'before' state.

scenes.visual: Creator runs hands through styled, voluminous, wavy, bouncy blowout hair.
scenes.action: Fluffs hair and smiles into the camera showcasing the 'after'.

scenes.visual: Creator holds section of hair and starts winding it around the pink WavyTalk thermal round brush.
scenes.action: Creator speaks to the camera while clipping hair and introducing the Blowout Boost.

scenes.visual: Creator holds brush and explains the 5 heat settings.
scenes.action: Points at the device and touches the handle.

scenes.visual: Close-up of the handle display on the WavyTalk tool showing the digital temperature numbers changing with button presses.
scenes.action: Thumb presses the button to cycle through the temperature levels.

scenes.visual: Creator demonstrates placing the brush at the roots and lifting, then curling downwards.
scenes.action: Slowly rolls the thermal brush through a lower hair section to create lift and curl.

scenes.visual: Creator rolls another side section of hair around the heated barrel.
scenes.action: Twists and slides the thermal brush smoothly out of the hair to reveal a bouncy wave.

scenes.visual: Creator styles the crown / front fringe section upwards.
scenes.action: Lifts the front bang section up and rolls back with the brush to create curtain bang volume.

scenes.visual: Creator running her fingers through full blowout hair, holding the pink WavyTalk brush next to her face.
scenes.action: Flaunts shiny, frizz-free blowout waves, points to brush barrel and ionic features.

scenes.visual: Creator holds the tool beside her head, smiling and gesturing to camera as offer details appear on screen.
scenes.action: Delivers final pitch with 20% discount and 30-day return policy.
